annotation.cut_point:
To find the total amount Harkamal paid, we need to calculate the cost of each item and then sum them up:

- Grapes: $ 10 \, \text{kg} \times 70 \, \text{per kg} = 700 $
- Mangoes: $ 9 \, \text{kg} \times 55 \, \text{per kg} = 495 $
- Apples: $ 12 \, \text{kg} \times 80 \, \text{per kg} = 960 $
- Papayas: $ 7 \, \text{kg} \times 45 \, \text{per kg} = 315 $
- Oranges: $ 15 \, \text{kg} \times 30 \, \text{per kg} = 450 $
- Bananas: $ 5 \, \text{kg} \times 25 \, \text{per kg} = 125 $

Now, add all these amounts together:

$$
700 + 495 + 960 + 315 + 450 + 125 = \boxed{2935} \, \text{rupees}
$$
